profile.headline: Software engineer (battery data) at Form Energy, Inc.
profile.summary: Software engineer specializing in interfaces for experimental design, data collection, and data analysis for scientific research. Passionate about technology development and behavioral changes needed to address climate change.

positions.title: Staff software engineer, battery data
positions.description: Developing tools for researchers to access and analyze data from battery experiments.

positions.title: Research scientist
positions.description:
Project lead for Lookit (lookit.mit.edu). Developed tools for online research with babies and children to make it easier to conduct rigorous, reproducible, & representative developmental research.
* Led development of the first online platform for developmental research. 
* Contributed to Django and Ember.js app development; responsible for designing new features and maintaining feature development roadmap.
* Wrote detailed technical documentation (lookit.readthedocs.io). 
* Designed policies to ensure high-quality research on platform and provided detailed feedback on all studies to improve data quality and family experience.
* Hired, trained, and supervised staff.
* Conducted behavioral research studies, created data processing pipeline in Python, and conducted data analysis and visualization in Python and R.
* Served as PI on NSF grant to expand Lookit.

positions.title: Lead instructor, LEAD program
positions.description: Taught classes in neuroscience to talented minority high school students as part of Caltech's LEAD summer program.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
* Developed spike sorting tools in MATLAB for use on long-term microelectrode recordings in behaving mice. 
* Characterized quality of recordings from new 64-channel neural probes and sources of variation in signals.

positions.title: Teaching assistant
positions.description: Assistance with labs and homework grading for a high school neuroscience course as part of Caltech's YESS summer program.

positions.title: Teaching assistant
positions.description: Did grading and held lab hours for the introductory computer science course, CS1 (taught in Scheme 2007, then Python 2008 and 2009).

positions.title: Amgen scholar
positions.description: Developed method to segregate pixels of ﬂuorescence resonance energy transfer (FRET) images based on probable similarity of stoichiometric composition.

positions.title: Richter scholar
positions.description: Analyzed human subthalamic nucleus recordings from human Parkinson's patients to determine the short-term eﬀects of nicotine on neuronal ﬁring patterns.
